title: Grilled Lamb Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Greek-inspired dish, perfect for warm weather. This recipe is gluten-free and showcases the rich taste of lamb.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder or leg, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until lamb reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Transfer skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
